list.title: Course creator
list.description: Write your own courses, then assign them to your classes or share them with your school.
list.heading: Your courses

empty.title: You have not created a course yet
empty.description: Start with a title and a short description. Then add modules, lessons, quizzes and projects.

list.structure: {modules, plural, =0 {No modules} one {# module} other {# modules}} · {lessons, plural, =0 {no lessons} one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}

adminList.title: Official courses
adminList.description: RoboHolic’s own courses. Learners find them in the catalog once they are published.
adminList.heading: All official courses

empty.title: No official course yet
empty.description: Create the first one, give it a pathway, then publish it.

newCourse.title: Create a course
newCourse.description: You can change all of this later. The course stays a draft until you publish it.
newCourse.languageHint: Write the title and the descriptions in this language. You can add a translation later.

fields.defaultLocaleHint: Fill in every required field in this language. Other languages are optional: learners see the default language where a translation is missing.
fields.title: Title
fields.summaryHint: One or two sentences, shown on the course card.
fields.outcomes: What learners will be able to do
fields.outcomesHint: One per line, up to {max, number} lines of up to {chars, number} characters.

audienceOptions.studentDescription: Learners aged 8 to 18. It can be assigned to classes.
audienceOptions.teacherDescription: Professional learning for educators. Teachers enrol themselves; it cannot be assigned to a class and has no projects.

fields.audienceLocked: This course has project blocks, so it stays a course for students.
fields.audiencePathway: The pathway {pathway} is for another audience. Put the course back to draft to change both.
fields.agesHint: Guidance only: ages never stop anyone from opening the course. Between {min, number} and {max, number}; leave empty for no limit.
fields.minutesHint: Up to {max, number} minutes. Shown to learners as {duration}.
fields.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas. Up to {max, number} tags.
fields.tagInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, up to {max, number} characters per tag.

visibilityOptions.privateDescription: You, the learners of the classes you assign it to, and your school’s administrators.
visibilityOptions.schoolDescription: Teachers of your school can also see it and assign it to their classes.

fields.visibilityNoSchool: Private: only you and the learners of the classes you assign it to can see it. Courses can be shared with a school once your account belongs to one.
fields.certificateDescription: Learners who finish the course get a certificate.
fields.pathwayLocked: Unpublish the course to move it to another pathway.
fields.orderHint: From 0 to {max, number}. Courses are listed from the lowest number to the highest.

accessTierOptions.freeDescription: Every learner who can see the course can open it.
accessTierOptions.premiumDescription: Only learners covered by a school licence or a subscription can open it.

fields.lessonXpHint: Learners earn it the first time they complete the lesson. Up to {max, number} XP.

status.title: Publishing

explanation.draft: Draft: it cannot be assigned, and nobody new can enrol, until it is published.
explanation.publishedPrivate: Published: it can be assigned to classes.
explanation.publishedSchool: Published: teachers of the school can also see it and assign it to their classes.
explanation.publishedForTeachers: Published: as a course for teachers, it is not assigned to classes. {visibility, select, school {Teachers of the school can open it and enrol.} other {While it is private, other teachers cannot see it.}}
explanation.publishedOfficial: Published: learners find it in the catalog, in the pathway {pathway}.
explanation.publishedOfficialNoPathway: Published: learners can open it, but it is in no pathway yet.
explanation.archived: Archived: it is hidden from the catalog and cannot be assigned.

status.notReady: The course is not ready to publish yet. Fix the points below first.

publish.title: Publish “{course}”?
publish.description: {audience, select, teacher {Teachers who can see it can then enrol.} other {It can then be assigned to classes.}}{visibility, select, school { Teachers of the school can also find it.} other {}}
publish.descriptionOfficial: Learners will find it in the catalog. Changes you save afterwards are visible to them at once.

unpublish.title: Put “{course}” back to draft?
unpublish.description: Nobody new can be assigned it or enrol in it. Learners already enrolled keep their access.
unpublish.descriptionOfficial: It disappears from the catalog, and learners already enrolled can no longer open it until you publish it again.

archive.title: Archive “{course}”?
archive.description: Nobody new can be assigned it or enrol in it. Learners already enrolled keep their access. You can restore it later.
archive.descriptionOfficial: It disappears from the catalog, and learners already enrolled can no longer open it. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore “{course}”?
restore.description: It becomes a draft again. Publish it when it is ready.

toast.unpublish: The course is a draft again.

readiness.title: Before you publish
readiness.noModules: Add at least one module with a lesson.
readiness.untranslatedCourse: The course details are not translated into {language} yet.
readiness.untranslatedModules: {count, plural, one {# module is} other {# modules are}} not translated into {language} yet.
readiness.untranslatedLessons: {count, plural, one {# lesson is} other {# lessons are}} not translated into {language} yet.
readiness.unusedQuizzes: {count, plural, one {# quiz is not used in any lesson, so learners will not see it.} other {# quizzes are not used in any lesson, so learners will not see them.}}
readiness.unusedProjects: {count, plural, one {# project is not used in any lesson, so learners will not see it.} other {# projects are not used in any lesson, so learners will not see them.}}
readiness.noCover: The course has no cover image.
readiness.ready: Everything needed is there. You can publish the course.

notices.live: This course is published: changes are visible to learners as soon as you save them.
notices.locked: Learners are enrolled in this course, so its modules, lessons, blocks, quizzes and projects can no longer be deleted. You can still edit and add content.
notices.teacherMade: This course was made by a teacher. Changes you save are visible to its author.
notices.quizLive: Changing the correct answers does not change the results of attempts already made.

outline.title: Modules and lessons

empty.title: This course has no modules yet
empty.description: A module groups lessons. Add a first module, then its lessons.

outline.moduleLimit: A course can have up to {max, number} modules.
outline.lessonCount: {count, plural, =0 {No lessons} one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}
outline.noLessons: No lessons in this module yet.
outline.lessonLimit: A module can have up to {max, number} lessons.
outline.lessonContents: {quizzes, plural, =0 {} one {# quiz · } other {# quizzes · }}{projects, plural, =0 {} one {# project · } other {# projects · }}{reflections, plural, =0 {no reflection} one {# reflection} other {# reflections}}

module.deleteDescription: The module has no lessons. This cannot be undone.
module.deleteHint: A module can be deleted once it has no lessons.

lesson.deleteDescription: {blocks, plural, =0 {The lesson has no blocks.} one {Its block is deleted too.} other {Its # blocks are deleted too.}} Quizzes and projects it uses stay in the course, unused. This cannot be undone.

details.heading: Course details
details.hardwareHint: Optional. Only for courses that use a robot, a camera or sensors.
details.nothingToSave: There is nothing new to save.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.hint: Shown on course cards. A wide image (16:9) works best.
cover.removeDescription: The course cards show no image until you upload a new one.

content.noQuizzesDescription: Create a quiz, then add it to a lesson with a quiz block.
content.noProjectsForTeachers: Courses for teachers have no projects: teachers do not submit work. Use reflection blocks instead.
content.noProjectsDescription: Create a project or an assignment, then add it to a lesson with a project block.
content.deleteDescription: It is not used in any lesson. This cannot be undone.

requirements.title: To complete this lesson
requirements.quizzes: {count, plural, one {Pass the quiz, or use all its attempts} other {Pass the # quizzes, or use all their attempts}}
requirements.projects: {count, plural, one {Submit the project} other {Submit the # projects}}
requirements.reflections: {count, plural, one {Write the reflection} other {Write the # reflections}}
requirements.none: Learners complete this lesson by opening it and selecting “Complete lesson”.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.limit: A lesson can have up to {max, number} blocks.

empty.title: This lesson has no blocks yet
empty.description: Blocks are the content of a lesson: text, images, videos, quizzes, activities and more.

blocks.stageHint: Learners see the blocks grouped by stage, in this order: Discover, Learn, Watch, Try, Ask AI, Build, Check, Reflect.
blocks.deleteLinkedDescription: What it shows stays in the course, unused, and can be added to a lesson again. This cannot be undone.
blocks.discardTitle: Discard your changes to this block?
blocks.discardDescription: The changes you have not saved will be lost.
blocks.orphan: This block was deleted in another tab or window.
blocks.saveAsNew: Save it as a new block

rich_text.label: Text
rich_text.description: Explanations with headings, lists and links (Markdown).

image.label: Image
image.description: A picture with a description for learners who cannot see it.

video.label: Video
video.description: A YouTube or Vimeo video, or a video file, with a transcript.

file.label: File
file.description: A worksheet or another file to download.

quiz.label: Quiz
quiz.description: Questions that learners answer to check what they know.

code_activity.label: Code activity
code_activity.description: Learners write code from a starting point.

ai_activity.label: AI activity
ai_activity.description: An activity done with Robo AI, the tutor.

embed.label: Embed
embed.description: A YouTube (privacy mode) or Vimeo player.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.description: A question learners answer in writing.

project.label: Project
project.description: A project or an assignment that learners submit.

richText.heading: Heading
richText.bodyHint: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, lists and links. Images go in an image block.

image.altHint: Describe the image for learners who cannot see it.
image.caption: Caption

video.idHint: Paste the address of the video, or its ID.
video.durationHint: Optional. Minutes and seconds, for example 4:30.
video.title: Video title
video.caption: Caption
video.transcriptHint: A transcript helps learners who cannot hear the video.

quiz.noneFree: Every quiz of this course is already used in a lesson. Create a new one.

ai.labToolHint: Optional. Suggests an AI Lab tool to students next to the activity.
ai.starterPromptHint: Learners can send it to Robo AI with one click, and change it first.

reflection.minLengthHint: Learners must write at least this many characters to complete the lesson (0 to {max, number}; 0 = no answer needed).

project.noneFree: Every project of this course is already used in a lesson. Create a new one.

reorder.moved: “{name}” moved to position {position, number} of {count, number}.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.description: You have changes that are not saved. If you leave this page, they will be lost.

conflict.title: This was changed somewhere else
conflict.description: Someone saved a new version, in another tab or on another device, while you were editing.

conflicts.pathwayLocked: Unpublish the course before you move it to another pathway.
conflicts.audienceHasProjects: This course has project blocks. Remove them before you make it a course for teachers: teachers do not submit projects.
conflicts.generic: Something changed in another tab or window. The page has been refreshed; check it and try again.
conflicts.tooManyModules: A course can have up to {max, number} modules.
conflicts.moduleHasLessons: Delete the lessons of this module first.
conflicts.locked: Learners are enrolled in this course, so its modules, lessons, blocks, quizzes and projects can no longer be deleted.
conflicts.tooManyLessons: A module can have up to {max, number} lessons.
conflicts.staleOrder: This list changed in another tab or window: an item was added or deleted. The page has been refreshed; try again.
conflicts.tooManyBlocks: A lesson can have up to {max, number} blocks.
conflicts.quizInUse: This quiz is already used by another block. Choose another quiz or create a new one.
conflicts.projectInUse: This project is already used by another block. Choose another project or create a new one.
conflicts.teacherCourseProject: Courses for teachers cannot contain projects. Use a reflection block instead.
conflicts.quizLinked: This quiz is used in a lesson. Remove its quiz block first.
conflicts.projectLinked: This project is used in a lesson. Remove its project block first.

errors.form: Some of the information could not be saved. Check the form and try again.
errors.gone: This was deleted in another tab or window. The page has been refreshed.
errors.mediaGone: This file is not part of this course any more. Upload it again.
errors.otherLanguage: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} in {language}.
errors.sessionEnded: Your changes are still here. Log in again in the new tab, then save again.

sync.pending: Changes were saved in another tab or window. Load them before you save yours: your unsaved changes stay on this page.

quiz.createdNotAdded: The quiz was saved, but it could not be added to the lesson. Add it with a quiz block.
quiz.willBeAdded: When you save it, this quiz is added to the end of the lesson “{lesson}”.
quiz.gone: This quiz was deleted in another tab or window. Your changes are still here.
quiz.saveAsNew: Save it as a new quiz
quiz.passingScoreHint: The score learners need to pass, from 0 to 100.
quiz.maxAttemptsHint: From 1 to {max, number}. Learners who use every attempt can still complete the lesson.
quiz.xpHint: Learners earn it the first time they pass. Up to {max, number} XP.
quiz.shuffleDescription: Each attempt shows the questions in a different order.

revealOptions.after_passDescription: Learners see the correct answers once they pass.
revealOptions.after_attemptDescription: Learners see the correct answers right after each attempt.

quiz.typeChangeDescription: The answers you wrote for this question will be removed.
quiz.explanationHint: Optional. Shown with the correct answers (see “Show the correct answers”).
quiz.acceptedAnswersHint: One per line, up to {max, number} answers of up to {chars, number} characters. Capitals, accents and extra spaces do not matter.

errors.acceptedRequired: Add at least one accepted answer in the default language.
errors.tooLarge: This quiz is too large to save. Shorten some texts or split it into two quizzes.

project.createdNotAdded: The project was saved, but it could not be added to the lesson. Add it with a project block.
project.willBeAdded: When you save it, this project is added to the end of the lesson “{lesson}”.
project.gone: This project was deleted in another tab or window. Your changes are still here.
project.saveAsNew: Save it as a new project
project.teacherCourse: Courses for teachers cannot use projects in their lessons.

kinds.projectDescription: Learners create something of their own and submit it.
kinds.assignmentDescription: A set task learners complete and submit.

project.requirementsHint: Say what learners must hand in and how it will be judged.
project.rubricHint: Choose the criteria the work is judged on and give each a weight. The weights must add up to 100.
project.xpHint: Learners earn it when their work is accepted. Up to {max, number} XP.
project.requiredForCertificateDescription: Learners get the course certificate only once this project is accepted.
